Quantification was performed using XIC of specific peptides corresponding to the inclusion or exclusion of exon 31.

scope: CHC immunoprecipitation was then performed on 300 µg protein lysates prepared in lysis buffer, precleared with 30 µl PGS, and incubated with 5 µg CHC antibody (Abcam; ab21679; RRID:AB_2083165) overnight at 4°C.
Pelleted PGS was then washed once with lysis buffer lowered to 0.1% NP-40, then thrice with ammonium bicarbonate (NH4)HCO3 25 mM before on-beads digestion with endoproteinase Glu-C.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically compares the protein isoforms of clathrin heavy chain (CHC) between undifferentiated myoblasts and differentiated myotubes to validate the alternative splicing of exon 31. While the broader study includes genetic perturbations (AAV-mediated exon skipping, siRNA), the MS analysis described in the 'Proteomics and mass spectrometry (MS) analysis' section and PRIDE metadata is limited to the differentiation comparison.

The search was performed against a custom database including the CHC Q00610 +/- ex31 sequences.
